reviews.text: Clear and efficient care after weeks of searching at another clinic. Clear explanations and gentle handling of our cat. I highly recommend them.

Marie Odile Sutter is an exceptional veterinarian. Thank you for being so caring and professional, with a kindness that is lacking in other veterinary clinics.
The staff are attentive even if you're not a "customer". I'll definitely be back as a "customer".

Exceptional care in an extremely distressing emergency situation.

My dog ​​recently had to be rushed to the hospital after suspected poisoning, with severe seizures and repeated vomiting. Her condition was particularly worrying.

I would like to sincerely thank Dr. Marie-Odile Sutter for her dedication, responsiveness, and commitment. She didn't just treat my dog; she sought to understand what could have caused her condition, contacted the various professionals involved to obtain precise information about the product to which she might have been exposed, and did everything possible to guide her care.

I have since learned that her condition is improving. I cannot medically quantify what led to this improvement, but one thing is certain: in my opinion, Dr. Sutter's dedication gave her every chance of recovery. I will be deeply grateful to her.

I would also like to extend a special thank you to Ms. Labat and the entire team present. In an emergency like this, their composure, availability, attentiveness to the animal, and support for the owner make a real difference. Their work is sometimes less visible than that of the veterinarian, but it is absolutely essential.

I work in the animal care industry myself, and I know how quickly negative reviews spread, especially on social media. It's obviously important to report problems when they exist, but I believe it's just as important to take the time to recognize the professionals who truly go the extra mile.

Thank you to the whole team for your professionalism, your compassion, and above all, for taking such wonderful care of my dog. ❤️
It's always a pleasure to entrust our dog to such a responsive and efficient team.
A wonderful experience! Gracie felt welcomed and loved!
I have been taking my cats to Dr. Sutter for several years now, and he listens to my concerns. I greatly appreciate his availability and professionalism.
My three cats' go-to vet. Very attentive and gentle with my furry babies. Warm welcome...very friendly and the clinic is impeccably clean. I call her for every little ailment.

With so many vets who only see us as walking wallets, it's truly wonderful to be treated this way and to have such a strong bond of trust with your vet. The few times I've been forced to see other vets, it's always ended in exorbitant bills and an appointment with Dr. Sutter to get my dog ​​the proper care she needs and the attention I expect from a competent veterinarian.

And what a team! The assistants are fantastic, always with a treat in their pocket and cuddles upon arrival 😁

I recommend them 100% (and I'd like to take this opportunity to thank the entire team and Dr. Sutter 🙏)

Is Dr. Sutter the best vet in Paris? In my humble opinion, YES. In a friendly setting with a fantastic and dynamic team, I wholeheartedly recommend this veterinary clinic. It's not the cheapest vet, nor the most expensive, certainly. But when you love your pet, want to take care of them, treat them, and understand them better, Dr. Sutter and her team are there, attentive to both the animals AND their owners. She's a dedicated vet who knows the names of the animals she treats, and that speaks volumes! She and her team are there through thick and thin, and in emergencies. I speak from experience. She's taken care of all my cats, from the most sociable to the most timid. They prioritize animal welfare and the owner/pet relationship, and provide clear explanations. I moved to the suburbs and I wouldn't change vets for anything. A thousand thanks to Dr. Sutter and his team ❤️🐈‍🦮🦜🐹👏🏻🙏🏻 from Jack, Elliott, and Mordor (of course) 🐈‍⬛ and the family cats, Cali and Fritz, and Chirac the cat who was abandoned by his owner :( They had a good life, and those who are still with us are doing wonderfully ✨💫🌟🫶🏻:).
